lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: SAY Entertainmeeeeeeeeeeeent!!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: I live to keep the Ark entertained!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: C'est moi, Mustang!!!!
What's up?

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: I hear mon Nikke

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: owes you one hell of a favor, oui?
You mean Julia?
You mean Anis?

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Oui, oui!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Oh! Your mémoire is absolutely dreadful!
Is it Julia?

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Oui! Bingo!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Merci for that!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: And while I'm at it, I have some très exciting news to share with you!
Exciting news?

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Did you hear?

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Julia's found her soul and is setting off on a journey! C'est magnifique, non?
Set off on a journey?

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Oui! She's embarked on a little voyage to the surface, mon ami.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: She wishes to lose herself in her own musique...

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: to savour the grand wave of music in all its gloire!
She went to the surface alone?

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Oui! Her violin is but a decoy, mon ami!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: She may not be able to attaquer Raptures,

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: but she can still make her escape!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: And she's agreed to return to the Ark once a month!
The higher-ups gave the go-ahead?

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Why would they say non?

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: I gave her the okay, after all.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: She has a perfectly good excuse: finding the musique left behind on the surface.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: So I have absolument no reason to say non!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Oh! Come to think of it,

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: I hear her première destination is the wilderness.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Maybe that mémoire of finding her soul

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: with someone

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: was très, très precious to her.
Why are you telling me this?

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Because I wanted to repay you for making Julia a true musicienne, you see?

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: And bien sûr, I wanted to give the hardworking girl

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: a little present.
When did she leave?

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Today!!!
Today?!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: She just announced she's heading to the surface, oui oui!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: If you want to see her, you'd better hurry, mon ami!
